data.name: Nibas
data.gender_notes: Nibas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nibas is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nivasa' which means 'dwelling' or 'house'. In Hindu mythology, Nibas is the name of a god associated with the home and hospitality. He is believed to bring peace, prosperity, and happiness to the household. The name Nibas carries the meaning “Lord of the House” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nibas usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the divine presence in one's home and the blessings of the gods for a peaceful and prosperous life.
data.etymology: Nibas belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the House.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nibas total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
